_comment: MellowHeart Dream (booth 6975498), Milfy fitting. The body bones alias on their own; the thumb is the one name the generic table does not carry.

The cardigan's forearm, hand and thumb bones are IGNORED. Fitting on all sixteen of its bones instead of the ten the shipped build was tuned on moves the cardigan's similarity scale from x1.153 to x1.188 and verify.py refuses the build: the grafted (No bra)Breasts_Cow shape key flips faces at the left armpit (one face with the translation-only fit, evidence/bonemap-0905-16anchors.log; five with Phase 2's rotation-aware fit, evidence/restpose-0905-16anchors.log). The tear is not the sleeve: straight out of outfit.pieces(), before hug, the worst three triangles are the same three at the bust whether the fit uses ten anchors, sixteen, sixteen without any turn or sixteen turning only the legs (evidence/restpose-0905-analysis.log), and the key already stretches them 1.79x on the shipped ten-anchor build. Lifting this needs the key smoothed at the armpit or the sleeves fitted on their own (Phase 4 binding), not a better rotation. The chains under these bones follow the upper arm.
